'''Business and economy'''
*[[Rupert Murdoch]] announces his retirement as the chairman of [[Fox Corporation]] and [[News Corp]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna111323 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are killed and five others are injured in an explosion at a [[gas pipeline]] in [[Vrancea County]], [[Romania]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/explosion-gas-pipeline-near-construction-site-romania-kills-four-2023-09-21/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and more than 40 others are injured when a bus rolls over in [[Wawayanda, New York|Wawayanda]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/rollover-bus-crash-new-york-leaves-40-injured-5-critically-rcna111440 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–India relations]]
**Death of [[Hardeep Singh Nijjar]]
***Amid a [[diplomatic crisis]], [[India]] suspends the issuance of [[travel visa]]s to [[Canada|Canadian]] citizens due to alleged security threats at its High Commission and consulates in Canada. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-66851964/ (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] confirms that the [[James Webb Space Telescope]] has identified [[carbon dioxide]] on the [[Moons of Jupiter|Jovian moon]] [[Europa (moon)|Europa]]. The carbon dioxide, detected in a specific region on the moon's icy surface is believed to have originated from within its [[Planetary oceanography|subsurface ocean]]. [https://www.nasa.gov/feature/goddard/2023/nasa-s-webb-finds-carbon-source-on-surface-of-jupiter-s-moon-europa (NASA)]
